caption: The drawing depicts a jug or pitcher shaped like a human figure, specifically dressed in what appears to be a historical military uniform including a large, prominent bicorne hat, a jacket with buttons, and high boots. The jug’s spout is integrated into the figure’s hat, while the handle is attached at the back and blends with the outline of the coat. The pose of the figure is upright with one hand tucked into the front of the jacket and the other hand at the side. The figure’s expression is stern and the form is somewhat rounded, stylized, and stout, with exaggerated proportions. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, likely graphite or pencil on paper, and shows careful shading to highlight the three-dimensional qualities and textures, including folds of the clothing and surface crackles. The background is plain and unadorned. There are some discolorations and marks present on the paper, and a faint signature or text is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Napoleon Toby Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
